proposed_fix_variants.variant_name: fix-H_F.1 — re-flip thinking=true on bg-task resumed assistant message
proposed_fix_variants.rationale: When SDK emits assistant message AFTER a prior result without any intervening user prompt (i.e., from <task-notification> wake), call updateThinking(true) so app sees babbling indicator return.

proposed_fix_variants.variant_name: fix-H_F.3 — one-shot keepAlive on socket reconnect (BA-QA Objection #5 recommendation)
proposed_fix_variants.rationale: On socket connect handler, after receiveSync.invalidate(), call this.keepAlive(this.lastKnownThinking, this.lastKnownMode) so server's lastActiveAt + ephemeral thinking snapshot bridges the reconnect gap (worst case 2s → instant). NOTE: requires storing lastKnownThinking on ApiSessionClient — currently only Session.ts holds thinking state.
